g.text: USB: data to the laptop dashboard + 5 V power

g.desc: USB: data to the laptop dashboard + 5 V power

g.text: I2C bus 0 (GPIO21 SDA, GPIO22 SCL): tip compass 0x0D, MPU6050 0x68, OLED 0x3C

g.desc: I2C bus 0 (GPIO21 SDA, GPIO22 SCL): tip compass 0x0D, MPU6050 0x68, OLED 0x3C

g.text: Buttons use the ESP32 internal pull-ups

g.desc: Buttons use the ESP32 internal pull-ups

g.text: J5: 5 V from a boost/charger board (TP4056 + MT3608, or IP5306) on an 18650 cell.

g.desc: J5: 5 V from a boost/charger board (TP4056 + MT3608, or IP5306) on an 18650 cell.

g.text: J2/J3 pin order: 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA

g.desc: J2/J3 pin order: 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA

g.text: I2C bus 1 (GPIO25 SDA, GPIO26 SCL): top compass 0x0D

g.desc: I2C bus 1 (GPIO25 SDA, GPIO26 SCL): top compass 0x0D

g.text: D1 stops USB power flowing back into the battery board. USB alone also powers everything.

g.desc: D1 stops USB power flowing back into the battery board. USB alone also powers everything.

g.text: Both compasses share address 0x0D, so each gets its own bus

g.desc: Both compasses share address 0x0D, so each gets its own bus

g.text: on a 10 cm ring, about 250-300 uH

g.desc: on a 10 cm ring, about 250-300 uH

g.text: PWR_FLAG marks GND as driven (ERC only)

g.desc: PWR_FLAG marks GND as driven (ERC only)

g.text: U1B squares the signal for the ESP32 pulse counter (GPIO34). Use film caps for C1/C2: ceramics drift with heat.

g.desc: U1B squares the signal for the ESP32 pulse counter (GPIO34). Use film caps for C1/C2: ceramics drift with heat.

g.text: Pierce oscillator: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L * C1*C2/(C1+C2))) = about 42 kHz

g.desc: Pierce oscillator: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L * C1*C2/(C1+C2))) = about 42 kHz

g.text: Tip compass sits in the probe tip next to the coil.

g.desc: Tip compass sits in the probe tip next to the coil.

g.text: Top compass sits about 30 cm higher (gradiometer).

g.desc: Top compass sits about 30 cm higher (gradiometer).

g.text: J4 order matches most 0.96in OLEDs: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA

g.desc: J4 order matches most 0.96in OLEDs: GND, VCC, SCL, SDA

g.text: GY-521 boards already carry I2C pull-ups

g.desc: GY-521 boards already carry I2C pull-ups

g.text: Unused inputs tied to GND, outputs left open

g.desc: Unused inputs tied to GND, outputs left open

g.text: C3 decoupling: place next to U1 pin 14

g.desc: C3 decoupling: place next to U1 pin 14

g.text: GPIO34 is input-only: fine for the oscillator signal
